resources.string: Student app for field activity attendance.
Ask your faculty member for the address shown on the server laptop. It changes when the hotspot changes.
Debug builds only. Uses made-up data so every screen can be tried without a server. Any password works; usernames starting with faculty show the faculty message.
A selfie taken with the camera does not prove who is holding the phone, and phone location can be inaccurate or altered. Faculty reviews uncertain results.
